comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This item can be produced in two different ways, both requiring the use of Transmutation Alchemy.

1. Craft a Damaged Notebook and use it as a base item. There are 8 different "Guidance for Prayer" recipes possible to choose from; however, the recipes can only be accessed from the Priest inside the Temple of Poseidon which can only be accessed from the Acropolis of Atlantis -- and only if Atlantis is currently in UWO.

Base Item: Damaged Notebook (crafting information on its respective page)
Skills: Alchemy R10/Handicrafts R11
Ingredients: Rare Books x5
Graphite x30
Sophia cost: 10,000
Result: Seeker's Memo

2. Use a Perception of Explorer as a base item. These can be easily obtained from beginner-level quests located in Europe, and unlock 8 different recipes from your Alchemy furniture. Although this can be done at any time, the materials required will be double what the Priest of Atlantis' "Guidance for Prayer" require.

Skills: Alchemy R10/Handicrafts R11
Base Item: Perception of Explorer
Ingredients:

Method #1 - Gold Dust x200 + Explorer's Household Medicine x100 + Element of Wisdom x40

Method #2 - Peridot x200 + Boulders x200 + The Sun's Gemstone x20

Method #3 - Rose x200 + Stone Sculpture x200 + Mysterious Damask Rose x20

Method #4 - Moonstone x200 + Marble x200 + Goddess Moonstone x20

Method #5 - Aventurine x200 + Bronze Sculpture x200 + Shining Heliolite x30

Method #6 - Olive Oil x200 + Ebony x200 + Glorious Olive Branch x20

Method #7 - Saltpetre x200 + Emerald x200 + Gemstone of Wisdom x30

Method #8 - Sapphire x200 + Clay x200 + Starlight Gemstone x30

Sophia cost: 7,000
Result: Seeker's Memo

The purpose of the Seeker's Memo is simple -- it allows players to select a specific discovery to unlock using the Book of Wisdom and a Legacy theme.

Suppose you have 6/7 discoveries from the Legendary Capital of Babylon (Hanging Gardens) Legacy theme... with a Seeker's Memo, you can collect 7 Legacy clues (it doesn't matter which ones) and then use the Seeker's Memo to select any of the discoveries on that Theme's list (12:00 to 0:00).

Please keep in mind you cannot use the Seeker's Memo to select a discovery which has a prerequisite such as another discovery or port permits. Odds are, you'll probably find all 7/7 discoveries of a legacy theme long before you farm the necessary ingredients/sophia required to craft a Seeker's Memo, too..

But as with all things in UWO, the choice of how to proceed is yours. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
